title: Modulith Rules: ArchUnit rules for module boundaries in modular monoliths
description: Modulith Rules is an open-source Java library of pre-built ArchUnit rules for enforcing module boundaries in modular monoliths. A single module declaration, written with a fluent API, YAML or package conventions, drives rules for allowed dependencies, internal-package protection, API-only access, module cycles and directional communication contracts, with optional rules for Spring applications. Every violation message names the offending class and ends with a concrete fix. The same declaration renders the module graph as a Mermaid diagram. The library runs at test time only and its core has no framework dependency.
